data.narrative:
Black Forest Labs is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, and Patrick Esser, having raised $300M to date. Valuation analysis relies on a peer-median approach across 7 comparable companies in the same sector and stage band, including Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Figure AI ($39.0B Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), and Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), alongside three additional private benchmarks and one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Stage-progression methodology was excluded due to data integrity issues: the reported $3.25B post-money valuation implies a step-up to $6.2B, which exceeds 20x the company's total capital raised and signals a likely mis-parse from funding trackers. The peer-median method is therefore the sole applicable triangulation approach. The seven-company cohort yields a median valuation of $14.0B, with a range spanning $5.6B (low) to $39.0B (high).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11.9B to $16.1B, centered at the peer median of $14.0B. Key uncertainties stem from the wide dispersion across the peer set ($33.4B spread) and the heterogeneity of stage and maturity within AI & Software venture capital, where recent funding velocity has produced material valuation variation. Confidence is further constrained by the single applicable method and limited public-market anchoring (one public comp).
